title: Chapter 72 Surrender
content:
Chapter 72 Surrender

Hearing the guard's message, Emperor Ling looked pleasantly surprised, stood up suddenly, wanted to speak, but remembered that he was so wrong, swallowed what he wanted to say quickly, and turned his head to look at the officials in the hall.

"All my loves, what do you think about the visit of the imperial envoy? Whether I have seen it or not, what is your opinion?"

For such things as taking the lead in surrendering, how could it happen to an emperor, the responsibility of the Han Dynasty's four hundred years of destruction? Can you find someone under your command to share it?

So Emperor Ling looked in the direction of his courtiers sinisterly, and said, he is not afraid that they will shut up and refuse to answer his words, at such a critical moment.

It was the time to show their loyalty to the emperor of Yuguo. If they didn't come out to speak out, wouldn't it mean that their hearts were for the Han Dynasty and they had two hearts?

And for some people who want to stand out and gain a certain status in Yuguo, this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity is exactly what they are looking for but can't find!

Sure enough, at the moment above the court, Sikong Wang Yun stood up. and said loudly to the emperor:

"Your Majesty, if the two countries are at war, if you don't kill the envoy, how can I, a big man, refuse to accept the imperial country's envoy to visit? Isn't this a disgrace to my big man's aura!"

What he said was just and fair, as if the Han Dynasty was in the upper hand, and he was an upright gentleman, a loyal minister and righteous man.

However, people who really understand the situation at this moment will definitely spit at him in their hearts after hearing it, bah, it sounds nice, who doesn't know that you want Emperor Ling to recruit the dead, and then perform well in front of the envoy, Fortunately, in the second club, I have a good future.

After Lingdi heard this, he also felt disgusted, and secretly despised this person, why didn't he realize that this pious guy was so hypocritical, he was so good-looking when he got a bargain, and he didn't even let others take advantage of it.

However, one person finally came out to answer his words, and then turned his head to look around. Seeing that the others didn't seem to move, he had no choice but to continue.

"Since Wang Aiqing is so sincere, then Wang Aiqing will go to meet the envoy! Presumably Aiqing will not disappoint me and lose the face of my man!"

Reluctantly agreed, but he still wanted to disgust this villain, making him so eager to betray the big man, so that he could have a good impression in front of his new master.

"Uh, yes, I will live up to the entrustment, and I will definitely entertain the imperial envoy so that they can see the majesty of my great man."

Inexplicably choked, but for this opportunity to get in touch with the envoys of the Imperial Kingdom at close range, General Zhengdong with hundreds of thousands of troops in his hand, Wang Yun would not care about face and refuse this great opportunity, so he was very straightforward agreed.

Da da da, following Wang Yun's sound, the sound of footsteps spread farther and farther, and gradually disappeared into nothingness. The entire hall fell into a burst of silence again. The empty hall was completely silent, only the crowd The sound of Chendi's breathing came slowly.

A few moments later, Sikong Wang Yun rushed all the way to the main gate of Luoyang, and quickly ordered the guards to open the gate to welcome the imperial envoys from outside the city to enter the city.

There was a creaking sound, and the heavy and thick gate was pulled open by dozens of soldiers, and then dozens of guards of honor lined up neatly, right in the middle of which Wang Yun stood,

As the gate opened, Wang Yun bent down and bowed down, and said loudly: "The servant of the lower kingdom, Wang Yun, is here to welcome the envoys of the upper kingdom. If there is any negligence, I hope the envoys of the Three Kingdoms will not blame me!"

What he said and did, can be said to be respectful to the extreme, showing the duty of a treacherous and traitorous minister, just like Qin Hui in the Song Dynasty.

"It's okay, Mr. Wang, please rise up, and it's common sense to spend some time to deliver the order, so what's the crime!"

Han Kai was also a little surprised by Wang Yun's shamelessness, but he continued to follow his words. Anyway, these are all beneficial to his own country. Why should he refuse others to serve the shameless things of the Han country?

Along the way, on the way to Luoyang Gongcheng, the two lovers and concubines talked harmoniously along the way, and there were endless compliments and flattery, and the atmosphere was very harmonious.

When someone talks, time flies, especially if one person compliments and enjoys it alone, they don't have much time, they feel that they have come to the palace, after a brief meeting, Wang Yun led Han Kai into Luoyang Within Miyagi.

Along the way, Wang Yun introduced the layout of the palace city to Han Kai, as well as allusions from various places, and he spoke clearly and logically, as if he was selling real estate to others, boasting about the benefits of his own house everywhere.

This kind of shamelessness has no integrity at all, and he can't wait to sell his master in exchange for a credit.

Not to mention Han Kai, even the subordinates around Wang Yun couldn't stand it any longer, and turned their heads away with blushing faces, looking at Han Kai in embarrassment.

Finally, although Wang Yun has been introducing various scenic spots along the way, after all, the distance from the palace gate to the main hall is not much, but he came to the front of the main hall in a short while.

Looking at Han Kai with a bit of embarrassment, he asked him to wait here in embarrassment, and immediately went to report to His Majesty, so that he could receive him immediately, and then hurriedly walked into the hall.

In the main hall, the Impatient Lingdi who was waiting at the moment saw Wang Yun approaching, with a very pleasant expression on his face, and said: "Wang Aiqing, the envoy has arrived, so what is his attitude?"

Wang Yun also said happily: "Your Majesty, in fact, he is already waiting outside the palace gate, waiting for His Majesty to summon him, and the envoy is also very kind, sincerely expressing his greetings to His Majesty the Emperor of Yu Kingdom!"

"Oh, it's already here, hurry up and summon me, I can't wait to meet with the Imperial Envoy!"

Following Lingdi's words, Wang Yun immediately left the palace, came to Han Kai who was waiting outside the door, and led him into the palace to meet Lingdi.

Han Kai slowly entered the palace, firstly after some etiquette, he expressed the emperor's goodwill towards Emperor Ling, and then slowly said his main topic.

"Han Huang, His Majesty the Emperor sent envoys to pay a visit like the Han Emperor. In addition to expressing greetings, there is also a discussion about the current war!" Han Kai did not get too wordy, and directly pointed to the topic.

Hearing Han Kai's words, Emperor Ling's face froze, and he secretly said in his heart, is it finally here? This big man's four hundred years of history will be ruined in my hands.

"The envoy doesn't need to be polite, just say what you want, I'm here to listen!" Lingdi's words caused a burst of inexplicable sadness among the few loyal ministers in the court, and the crying gradually sounded.

"Now I have a large imperial army coming to the city, with millions of troops, ten thousand of good generals, and countless advisers like princes crossing the river. But now that the big man is sitting in a lonely city, it is already dusk, and it won't last long. I hope the emperor of the Han Dynasty will take the thought of the people of Luoyang , Kaesong surrender, to avoid the disaster of swords!"

The majestic and confident words came out of Han Kai's mouth, and many people in the town's court hall changed their complexions, and their faces were a little pale.

The same is true for Lingdi, his face was a little pale, and a trace of sweat gradually broke out on his forehead, but he still managed to pull himself together, and said in a weak tone:

"Then I don't know how my clan members of the Han Dynasty ended after Kaesong surrendered. Was the whole clan killed? Or exiled for thousands of miles?"

Hearing Emperor Ling's questioning, Han Kai understood that the high-ranking emperor in front of him had lost the spirit in her heart, and his determination to resist had been shaken.

The reason why he did not give up his resistance was because he was afraid that he would meet a tragic fate after surrendering.

Thinking of this, he couldn't help smiling, and slowly stated the conditions he got from Zhong Yu, which made Ling Emperor's face that was a little scared suddenly happy, and said in surprise: "So, I am willing to surrender!"
